sql: SELECT d.jobid, count(*) AS runs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status <> 'succeeded') AS fails, min(d.start_time) AS desde, max(d.start_time) AS ultima, round(avg(extract(epoch FROM (d.end_time - d.start_time)))::numeric, 2) AS seg_media, max(left(d.return_message, 80)) FILTER (WHERE d.status <> 'succeeded') AS erro FROM (SELECT * FROM cron.job_run_details ORDER BY runid DESC LIMIT 30000) d GROUP BY d.jobid ORDER BY d.jobid
